text:
Tim Stützle has 13 goals and 31 points in 26 games, and SenShot thinks it's time the league took notice. He took a scary run into a goalpost against Calgary on Nov. 23 but played 23 minutes two nights later, so the scare looks like just that.

The goals are where our numbers push back. He has 13 on 7.7 expected goals (the quality of his chances), shooting 22% against 18% last season, and that rate rarely lasts. His own chances are actually down this season, and his last ten games produced 2.3 expected goals against a usual 3.3. What hasn't changed is the motor. NHL Edge counts 93 bursts over 20 mph, 98th percentile, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 62% of his entries last season. Evolving-Hockey noted the cost too: opponents got more chances with him on the ice than with almost any forward. Our numbers project about 94 points. Watch the shot totals: 58 in 26 games is thin for a top-line scorer.
headline: Stützle is scoring on fewer chances
